fullTextEN: Hello everyone,
I am Xika from Taiwan.
Two years ago,

fullTextZH: 我在英国嫁给了一个英国人。
fullTextEN: I married a British person in the UK.

fullTextZH: 今天我想和大家分享嫁给英国人带给我的 5 个体验。
fullTextEN: Today I want to share with everyone 5 experiences from marrying a British person.
First,

fullTextZH: 如果对方的爸爸妈妈不喜欢你，
fullTextEN: If the other person's parents don't like you,
don't worry too much.
In Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 我们总是想办法要让男朋友或女朋友的父母喜欢我们。
fullTextEN: we always try to make our boyfriend's or girlfriend's parents like us.

fullTextZH: 所以第一次我要和男朋友的父母见面时，
fullTextEN: So the first time I was going to meet my boyfriend's parents,
I was very, very nervous,

fullTextZH: 这让我的男朋友很不解，
fullTextEN: which made my boyfriend very puzzled,

fullTextZH: 因为在中国文化里结婚不只是两个人的事，
fullTextEN: because in Chinese culture, marriage is not just between two people,
but a matter of two families.

fullTextZH: 所以如果父母不喜欢其中一个，
fullTextEN: So if the parents don't like one of them,

fullTextZH: 可能会影响两个人的关系，
fullTextEN: it might affect the relationship between the two,

fullTextZH: 甚至可能会阻止你们结婚。
fullTextEN: and might even prevent you from getting married.

fullTextZH: 但是对英国人还有很多西方国家的人来说，
fullTextEN: But for British people and many people from Western countries,

fullTextZH: 恋爱和结婚是两个人的事，
fullTextEN: dating and marriage are matters between two people,

fullTextZH: 父母的喜好可能会有一点影响，
fullTextEN: Parents' preferences might have a little influence,
but it's not that important.
Second,

fullTextZH: 在英国结婚前要先公告，
fullTextEN: In the UK, you must announce before getting married,
which means telling everyone,
we are getting married.
Right,
you must announce 28 days in advance.

fullTextZH: 因为在台湾没有这样的规定，
fullTextEN: Because there is no such rule in Taiwan,
so at that time I thought,

fullTextZH: 难道会有女人反对我们结婚？
fullTextEN: could there be a woman opposing our marriage?
Of course,

fullTextZH: 这是为了确保我们结婚是合法的。
fullTextEN: this is to ensure our marriage is legal.
You can oppose our marriage,

fullTextZH: 但是你要给一个合法的理由。
fullTextEN: but you must provide a legal reason.

fullTextZH: 那个时候我和先生去做结婚公告，
fullTextEN: At that time, my husband and I went to make the marriage announcement,
we had to be interviewed separately.

fullTextZH: 我们都记错了对方的生日，
fullTextEN: We both got each other's birthdays wrong,
it was really close,
but we still got married smoothly.
Third,

fullTextZH: 只要是结婚要用的东西，
fullTextEN: As long as it's something needed for a wedding,
the price doubles,
it becomes very, very expensive.

fullTextZH: 可能你的国家也有这种现象，
fullTextEN: Maybe your country also has this phenomenon,

fullTextZH: 不管是礼服，花还是摄影师，
fullTextEN: whether it's a dress, flowers, or a photographer,

fullTextZH: 只要跟店家说是结婚要用的，
fullTextEN: as long as you tell the shop it's for a wedding,
the price becomes very expensive.

fullTextZH: 那个时候我到洗衣店去送洗我的结婚礼服，
fullTextEN: At that time, I went to the laundry to send my wedding dress for cleaning,

fullTextZH: 看到价目表我吓了一大跳，
fullTextEN: I was shocked when I saw the price list,

fullTextZH: 所以我跟店家说我想送洗这件礼服，
fullTextEN: so I told the shop I wanted to send this dress for cleaning,

fullTextZH: 店家说这是结婚礼服吧，
fullTextEN: the shop said this is a wedding dress, right?
I said no,
it's just an ordinary dress.
It just happens to be white.
The shop suspiciously said,

fullTextZH: 我看就很像结婚礼服啊。
fullTextEN: I think it looks very much like a wedding dress.
I still insisted it wasn't,

fullTextZH: 是一件我参加晚宴要穿的礼服。
fullTextEN: it's a dress I wear to attend a banquet.
In the end, I saved some money.
Fourth,

fullTextZH: 可以直接叫公公婆婆或其他亲戚长辈的名字。
fullTextEN: You can directly call your father-in-law, mother-in-law, or other elder relatives by their names.
Father-in-law is the husband's father,
Mother-in-law is the husband's mother.
In Chinese culture,
If you are married,

fullTextZH: 你应该叫对方的父母爸爸妈妈，
fullTextEN: You should call your partner's parents mom and dad,

fullTextZH: 绝对不可以直接叫长辈的名字，
fullTextEN: You absolutely should not call elders by their names directly,

fullTextZH: 因为这是不尊重长辈的行为。
fullTextEN: because this is disrespectful to elders.
So regarding this point,
I was initially very unaccustomed,

fullTextZH: 觉得直接叫公公婆婆的名字很不礼貌，
fullTextEN: I felt that calling my father-in-law and mother-in-law by their names was very impolite,
but my husband said,

fullTextZH: 如果我叫他们爸爸妈妈，
fullTextEN: If I call them mom and dad,
they would find it very strange,

fullTextZH: 我才开口叫他们的名字，
fullTextEN: so I started calling them by their names,

fullTextZH: 现在我习惯了直接叫他们的名字。
fullTextEN: Now I am used to calling them by their names directly.
Okay,

fullTextZH: 最后一个让很多人惊讶的一点就是，和英国人结婚不代表可以合法住在英国。
fullTextEN: The last surprising point for many people is that marrying a British person does not mean you can legally live in the UK.
After marrying a British person,
You need to apply for a visa,
To apply for this visa,
Having only a marriage certificate is not enough,

fullTextZH: 还要证明你们结婚后有住在一起，
fullTextEN: You also need to prove that you lived together after marriage,
Your English ability is good enough,

fullTextZH: 你们有足够的收入等等。
fullTextEN: You have sufficient income, etc.
I am very curious,

fullTextZH: 你们对结婚这件人生大事还有什么样的体验或想法呢？
fullTextEN: What are your experiences or thoughts on this major life event of marriage?
You are welcome to leave comments and share,
Thank you,
Bye!
